exposure: Colour Doppler ultrasonography signs of placenta accreta (numerous vascular lacunae, loss of subplacental sonolucent space, absent lower uterine segment between bladder-placenta, turbulent or complicated blood flow at the uteroplacental interface)
outcome: Accuracy of colour Doppler ultrasonography to diagnose placenta accreta
cohort: 12 cases of suspected placenta accreta by ultrasonography between January 2008 and December 2012
finding: Colour Doppler ultrasonography appears useful in the antenatal diagnosis of placenta accreta.
gest_age: Median gestational age at first diagnosis was 24 weeks
